3a

Any two of the following:

Gas molecules are considered tiny, point-like particles that have the same mass.

The volume of each molecule is negligible compared to the total volume of the gas.

Intermolecular forces between the particles are negligible.

The gas molecules only have kinetic energy.

All collisions that take place are elastic.

The duration of collisions is negligible compared to the time between collisions.

At any moment, the number of molecules moving in one direction is the same as the number of molecules moving in any other direction.

The effects of gravity are ignored.
